title: Fix disallowed origin error and route id/path conflict crash

requirements.text: Audit the entire frontend codebase for all locations that perform origin validation on incoming `postMessage` events or that construct/check allowed-origin lists for iframe communication — including any `window.addEventListener('message', handler)` callbacks that check `event.origin`, any hardcoded origin whitelist arrays, and any Content-Security-Policy `<meta>` tags in `frontend/index.html`. Ensure `https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` is present in every such whitelist. Remove or broaden any overly restrictive origin checks that would cause a `draft-editor:error disallowed origin` error for this domain. The fix must not introduce security regressions for other already-allowed origins.
acceptanceCriteria: No `draft-editor:error disallowed origin` console error appears when the app is loaded at https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz.
`https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz` is present in every postMessage origin whitelist and CSP frame-ancestors/frame-src directive in `frontend/index.html`.
Other previously allowed origins continue to work without regression.

requirements.text: Audit `frontend/src/App.tsx` to identify and fix every route definition that simultaneously sets both an `id` and a `path` option on the same route object. TanStack Router (or React Router) does not permit a route to have both options at once — remove or rename the conflicting `id` property on any such route so the router initializes without throwing 'Route cannot have both an id and a path option'. Verify that all existing route paths and their navigation links remain functional after the fix.

quotes: index-zqd3Repb.js:32324 Uncaught Error: Route cannot have both an 'id' and a 'path' option.

acceptanceCriteria: The app loads in the browser without throwing 'Route cannot have both an id and a path option' or any related uncaught router error.
No route in `App.tsx` has both an `id` and a `path` property set simultaneously.
All existing routes (public and admin) remain accessible and navigable after the fix.
The browser console shows no uncaught JavaScript errors on initial page load.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Origin whitelist changes must not remove or break any existing allowed origins.
Route fix must preserve all existing route paths and their associated page components.
nonGoals: Modifying authentication flows beyond what is needed to fix the two reported errors.
